operations.summary: Save the platform administration access allowlist
operations.description: Requires system_configuration.manage on the platform scope. When enabled, platform-scope sign-in, refresh and every platform-scope session request must come from an allowed address or CIDR prefix; loopback is always allowed; tenant sessions and API keys are not affected. A policy that would not allow the saving request's own address is refused (422 admin_access_self_lockout). Recovery when locked out: run `control-api admin-access-allowlist disable` as root on the control host. Requests refused by the policy get 403 admin_access_denied.
